reader.requirement: At --std 85, in every PERFORM format that admits procedure-name-1 THRU procedure-name-2 (formats 1 to 4, paragraph or section names), THROUGH and THRU must be accepted interchangeably and produce the identical range.

edition-consulted.switches: THROUGH and THRU reserved; both rows true at all four editions

reader.edition-search: grep THRU/THROUGH over the grammar (one alternative '(THRU | THROUGH)') and the binder (p.THRU() is not null || p.THROUGH() is not null); grep "THRU" over src .cs: ReservedWords table, directive words, preprocessor only
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness covers paragraph ranges in format 1 and format 3; not exercised: section names, a paragraph-to-section range, format 2 TIMES and format 4 VARYING with TEST AFTER

probes.printed: SECT-THRU 2100 / SECT-THROUGH 2100; TIMES-THRU 0022 / TIMES-THROUGH 0022; VARY-THRU 0033 03 / VARY-THROUGH 0033 03; MIXED-THRU 2111 / MIXED-THROUGH 2111
probes.expected: each pair identical and equal to the GR7 range: S1..S2 = 2100, 2 x 11 = 22, 3 x 11 = 33 with I=3, P1..S2 = 2111

probes.printed: error COBOL5506: unexpected 'THROUGH' ... expected a user-defined word, ALTER, AUTHOR, CD, ...
probes.expected: THRU THROUGH is not a format: refused

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR6  (6.21.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6

reader.notes: Both words are distinct lexer tokens joined in one grammar alternative and one binder test, so no path can tell them apart. The refusal's expected-token list at --std 85 names words that are reserved at 1985 (ALTER, AUTHOR, CD...) as if they could stand there; that is a diagnostic-quality matter outside this rule.

refuter.evidence: refute-1985-159/thru1.cob at --std 85 (runs/thru1-001): lowercase 'perform p1 through p2' 0011, mixed-case 'Thru' 0011, format 3 WITH TEST AFTER THROUGH 0033 = THRU 0033, format 4 with AFTER and THROUGH split across lines 'VARY-AFTER 03 0000' (GR10d 1 termination values), P2 THROUGH P2 0010, THROUGH inside a declarative section run after a failed OPEN (status 35) 'DECL 0011 35'. thru2.cob 'PERFORM P2 THROUGH.' refused COBOL0001 (runs/thru2-001). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR6 'The words THROUGH and THRU are equivalent'; OK §1985:IV.4.2.2.1 'Each lowercase letter is' (lowercase reserved words equivalent at 1985). No later-edition form of the THRU phrase exists to refuse (class c not applicable).
